title: SVRL — Self-Verification via Reinforcement Learning
description: Project page for our ECCV 2026 paper: an RL-only finetuning framework that teaches compact multimodal agents to decide when to search, write better queries, and verify retrieved evidence inside their own reasoning traces.

title: Visualizing Gaze-Guided Attention in Atari
description: An interactive visualization exploring human gaze patterns, fixation stability, and spatial attention across six Atari games using the Atari-HEAD eye-tracking dataset, comparing normal play with high-score sessions.

title: Examining LLM Cognition Through Puzzles and Optical Illusions
description: An investigation into whether large language models exhibit human-like cognitive biases when presented with classic puzzles, checker-shadow illusions, and visual reasoning tasks.

title: Spatio-Temporal Abstractions in Reinforcement Learning
description: Exploring how hierarchical spatio-temporal abstractions can improve sample efficiency and generalization in deep RL agents navigating complex environments.
